cuts.rationale: S1 opening: B-720 at initial impact. Still primary with slow zoompan (max 1.15x) to add motion to static NASA photo. Source card shows asset id, center, rights_basis.

S1/S2 approach: remote-piloted B-720 approaching impact site. Archive insert as 640x480 2x-framed on dark background with thin white frame and source card. Source head static 0-6s trimmed per rights_records.
S2 practice run: B-720 making close approach over prepared impact site. Still primary with slow zoompan.
S3 after impact: B-720 enveloped in fireball after striking wing cutter. Still primary with slow zoompan.
S4 wing cutter strike: B-720 slid sideways after controlled impact, almost enveloped in fireball. Still primary with slow zoompan.
S5 cabin: crash test dummies in passenger cabin. Still primary with slow zoompan. Identifiable_persons: none (dummies).
S6 impact: left wing strikes ground first. Archive insert as 640x480 2x-framed insert with source card. Source head static 1-6s trimmed.
S7 fireball: fuel ignition and massive fireball. Archive insert as 640x480 2x-framed insert with source card.
S8 aftermath: modified fuel did not prevent fire, FAA ended additive requirements. Original graphics card with key numbers and claim_ids, plus FAA source card overlay. Static by design.

static_segments.reason: S8 graphics card is intentionally static - text/informational card, not footage

notes: All 8 assets source_policy_us_gov (NASA.gov + archive.org NIX). No third-party credit. No identifiable persons (crash test dummies only). No logos visible. Media is gitignored; regenerated from committed manifest via scripts/rebuild_slice_assets.sh.
